hypotheses.ETH: A causal ATR-and-structure stop clamped to 60-120 bps and resized to the same modeled dollar barrier risk reduces fixed-60 tactical whipsaws without worsening confirmation drawdown or relying on the largest winner.
hypotheses.BRENTOIL: A previously declared completed-bar profit lock improves both long and short current-identity lifecycles relative to the no-lock 24-hour fallback after costs.

eth_promotion_criteria: positive equal-risk net delta in construction and confirmation
positive equal-risk net excluding largest winner in both partitions
no worse confirmation equal-risk maximum drawdown
nonnegative confirmation long and short slices
opened-final descriptive net-delta sign does not contradict confirmation
brentoil_promotion_criteria: at least one resolved post-registration current-identity long and short
positive after-cost delta for each side
positive leave-largest delta across eligible confirmation lifecycles
assumptions: completed one-minute OHLC cannot resolve private IOC queue state or adverse intrabar ordering
linear equal-risk notional scaling is an exposure comparison, not a shared-account capital forecast
the previously opened final ETH block can audit contradiction but cannot supply untouched confirmation
the excluded BRENTOIL long may describe mechanism behavior but cannot satisfy prospective side coverage
falsifiers: any source hash or route identity changes
the candidate uses a candle unavailable at signal time
entry timestamps differ between control and candidate source cohorts
counterfactual costs, funding, occupancy, or stop precedence are omitted
